items.name: Brown Kitty
items.description: They are quiet and gentle in nature, so they don't go craving for food too often. They don't seem to be too obedient of their owners.

items.name: Brown Puppy
items.description: They are outgoing and active in nature, so they can't sit still for a period of time, which makes them hungry often. They are very obedient of their owners.

items.name: Pink Bunny
items.description: They are quiet and well-behaved in general, so they don't need to be fed more than the usual amount. Smart and obedient, but they also tend to be quite stubborn.

items.name: Mini Kargo
items.description: They are very very active, so they get hungry pretty often. Very intelligent, they are quite obedient of their owners.

items.name: Black Kitty
items.description: They are quiet and gentle in nature, so they don't go craving for food too often. They don't seem to be too obedient of their owners.

items.name: White Bunny
items.description: They are quiet and well-behaved in general, so they don't need to be fed more than the usual amount. Smart and obedient, but they also tend to be quite stubborn.

items.name: Husky
items.description: Active, yet calm at times. Can be moderately fed. Very smart in general.

items.name: Black Pig
items.description: Very active and hungry at all times. Need to be fed often. Very friendly in nature, so it's easy to increase the level of closeness with it.

items.name: Panda
items.description: Calm, relaxed, and gentle. A very rare creature. Comes with the Panda quote bubble and the label.

items.name: Dino Boy
items.description: A very adorable male baby dinosaur that is both active and unpredictable. Comes with a yellow dino quote bubble and the label.

items.name: Dino Girl
items.description: A very adorable female baby dinosaur that is both active and unpredictable. Comes with a pink dino quote bubble and the label.

items.name: Rudolph
items.description: They are smart and obedient by nature, picking up commands faster than other pets, but they also can get hungry in a hurry.

items.name: Sunny Day
items.description: A special effect in which you'll see a brightly smiling sun floating next to you. Designate a HotKey to turn the effect on/off.

items.name: Moon & the Stars
items.description: A special effect in which you'll see a set of glittering stars and brightly shining moon floating next to you. Designate a HotKey to turn the effect on/off.

items.name: Colorful Rainbow
items.description: A special effect in which you'll see a rainbow in its full 7 colors floating next to you. Designate a HotKey to turn the effect on/off.

items.name: Little Devil
items.description: A special effect in which you'll see Lilly the cute little devil floating around next to you. Designate a HotKey to turn the effect on/off.

items.name: Underwater
items.description: A special effect that shows a submarine under the water.  Designate a HotKey to turn the effect on/off.

items.name: Looking for Love
items.description: A special effect that displays the longing to be with someone special.  Designate a HotKey to turn the effect on/off.

items.name: Baby Angel
items.description: A lovely effect that shows a baby angel floating around as your protector.  Designate a HotKey to turn the effect on/off.

items.name: Wanted Poster
items.description: A special effect that puts a poster in front of your face as if you're being wanted around the world.  Designate a HotKey to turn the effect on/off.
